representations.name: Arbitrary constant stable tail
representations.new_information: Keeps arbitrary q-independent A_4,B_4 while retaining the exact H/q staircase.
representations.first_test: Derive the bottom Pascal recurrence without substituting 25,58.

representations.name: Finite reset menu
representations.new_information: Takes one simultaneous maximum over finitely many reset thresholds.
representations.first_test: Build a four-pair menu and certify one q defeats all pairs through rank ten.

representations.name: Affine Pascal transfer
representations.new_information: Separates the invariant -4q slope from recursively changing constants.
representations.first_test: Verify both bottom borrow identities symbolically.

representations.name: Menu-rank diagonal quantifier
representations.new_information: Records forall finite menu forall fixed R exists one later odd j.
representations.first_test: Specialize to R=42 without swapping quantifiers.

representations.name: q-dependent reset digits
representations.new_information: Allows reset tails of order q that can change the leading coefficient.
representations.first_test: Demand an actual legal reset formula with q-scaling.

representations.name: Leading-block switch
representations.new_information: Changes an H or q staircase term rather than only its bottom constants.
representations.first_test: Recompute the leading Pascal coefficient after a proposed switch.

representations.name: Reset-menu entropy
representations.new_information: Distinguishes fixed menus from menus whose content grows with q.
representations.first_test: Bound the number of legal q-dependent reset profiles.

representations.name: Switched-seed suffix interface
representations.new_information: Retains persistence and the final public antichain implication.
representations.first_test: Require a suffix theorem on the same legal domain as the switch.
